'''Shawn Beck''' is a Star Wars CCG player who finished 11th at [[March 2002 Dittmer tournament]] in March 2002, according to Jason Gillman's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d3516">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/ Dittmer MO standings (DeckTech report d3516; listed in the archive index)], DeckTech (Jason "3RD EYE" Gillman, 20 March 2002). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
